title: Xfinity Moving - Transfer Your Xfinity Service
description: Moving? Transfer Xfinity services to your new address in just 3 steps! Check availability at your new home right now.

headings.text: Sign in to start your move as an Xfinity member
Get online between addresses with WiFi hotspots
Even if your internet equipment is still packed away, connect with Xfinity WiFi hotspots whenever you need it. Included with Xfinity Internet at no extra charge.
Get coverage you can count on and enjoy savings when you add Xfinity Mobile to your internet plan.

body: Offer ends 7/21. New Xfinity Internet members. Restrictions apply. Autopay w/ stored bank account and paperless billing req'd. Taxes and fees extra and subj. to change. Reliability: Xfinity Internet is powered by fiber and connected to premises by coaxial cable.
Look up your new address and see available deals to take with you on move-in day.
